name: Evanston Summer Side Events 2023
information: This competition is in series with [Evanston Summer Big Cubes 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EvanstonSummerBigCubes2023) and [Lisle Summer 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LisleSummer2023). You will only be allowed to compete in one of these three competitions. Please read all tabs before registering. On the day of the competition, allow at least 15 extra minutes to locate the venue. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2hHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d8deb26fa25693dbb08d9ff3efd5ab04c32f3ffc/image.png)
